name: postinstall-guard-fixture
description: A fixture whose postinstall script MUST NOT run. See test/repo/web_lint_test.go — CI installs with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts`, and this proves the flag holds. If postinstall ran, it would create the sentinel file the test asserts is absent.

scripts.postinstall: node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('postinstall-ran.sentinel','a lifecycle script executed during install\n')"
